category_edits.rationale: Learn bilinear compatibility s(h,i)=h^T W e_i, with W initialized to identity. Apply the same jointly trained matrix to training and prediction while preserving the Transformer, history readout, loss, optimizer and hyperparameters. The embedded predictor already imports the updated SASRec class and loads its full state_dict, including W, so no writer change is needed. Each dataset retains one model.

pos_embs = self.item_emb(pos)
        neg_embs = self.item_emb(neg)
        pos_logits = (log_feats * pos_embs).sum(dim=-1)
        neg_logits = (log_feats * neg_embs).sum(dim=-1)
edits.replace:
pos_embs = self.item_emb(pos)
        neg_embs = self.item_emb(neg)
        scoring_feats = log_feats.matmul(self.interaction_matrix)
        pos_logits = (scoring_feats * pos_embs).sum(dim=-1)
        neg_logits = (scoring_feats * neg_embs).sum(dim=-1)

change_summary: Replace dot-product scoring with an identity-initialized, jointly trained bilinear scorer for all four category models. Preserve existing training settings, routing and checkpoint loading.
